## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Verification

- [ ] Unit tests pass.
- [ ] Debug build succeeds.
- [ ] Android lint passes.
- [ ] Release build succeeds.
- [ ] Relevant physical watch or vehicle testing is described below.

## Security and privacy

- [ ] No new internet, Bluetooth, account, location, or storage permission was
      added without an architecture and threat-model review.
- [ ] No credential, private key, VIN, pairing code, account information, or
      identifying vehicle log is included.
- [ ] Documentation and tests were updated for changed protocol or security
      behavior.

## Hardware testing

List the watch model, Wear OS version, vehicle model/year, vehicle software
version, and operations tested. Do not include a VIN or other personal data.
